critical_code_review_comments: pin-login.tsx L23-30 / L179-246 — IDENT_TABS array cleanly declares 3 tabs (phone/email/login_id) with matching testIDs pin-ident-<key>. The 'usernameMode = true' flag (L56) makes the PIN|Password segment show for ALL tabs — this matches the review request. On submit, the email/phone branch hits /auth/pin-login with body[identType]=v, and the password branch always hits /auth/employee-password-login with {login_id: v, password: p} — note: even when the user selected the Email or Mobile tab + Password mode, the frontend still sends the identifier under the 'login_id' key. Backend was already curl-verified to accept email/phone under this endpoint too, so no bug; just an implementation detail worth noting.

salary-run.tsx L890-903 — Roll chips reduced to ['on','off'] only, and the 'All' option was removed. Block message at L405-410 fires when rollFilter==='all' (the initial state), so any un-selected generate call is safely blocked before hitting the backend.

employee-master.tsx L280-290 — Duty Hours card visibility is gated on the firm's salary_process.offline_salary OR salary_process.attendance_source==='manual_editable' (Actual Salary mode). Card correctly hidden when offline_salary is false — matches the spec.

accident_register.py _sync_esic_leave — creates approved esic_leaves entry with source='accident_register' and linked_leave_id; days computed as inclusive range → 3 for 11..13. manual_attendance.py _grid L122-140 makes EL WIN over punches. Both work end-to-end.
